rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the social or political philosophy that puts individual freedom and self-reliance first.

example.english: This system values individualism and protects everyone’s freedom to make their own decisions.
example.traditional: 呢套制度重視個人主義，保障每個人自己作決定嘅自由。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 zai3 dou6 zung6 si6 go3 jan4 zyu2 ji6 bou2 zoeng3 mui5 go3 jan4 zi6 gei2 zok3 kyut3 ding6 ge3 zi6 jau4

rows.note: Use this when individualism means personal independence, especially acting or deciding without relying on others.

example.english: They have always shown individualism, making their own decisions without needing anyone to arrange things.
example.traditional: 佢由細到大都好自主，唔使人安排都識得自己作決定。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 zi6 zyu2 m4 sai2 jan4 on1 paai4 dou1 sik1 dak1 zi6 gei2 zok3 kyut3 ding6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the individualism shows in someone’s distinctive style, fashion, or way of thinking.

example.english: This outfit really shows their individualism; they do not follow trends at all.
example.traditional: 呢套衫好有佢嘅個人風格，完全唔跟人哋潮流。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 saam1 hou2 jau5 keoi5 ge3 go3 jan4 fung1 gaak3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 gan1 jan4 dei6 ciu4 lau4
